_comment: Release notes per versionName. Shown in the app's What's new popup (WhatsNew.kt) and used as the GitHub release notes by the githubRelease Gradle task. Newest version first. icon: favorite, share, navbar, chart, timer, weight, workout, calendar, home, settings, backup, update, bug, speed, star.

3.9.2.title: Settings in categories
3.9.2.text: Settings is now a short list: Appearance, Music, Timer, Permissions, Backup & data, Subscription and Help. Tap one to open it; Back returns to the list.

3.9.2.title: Strap battery
3.9.2.text: Settings → Timer → Heart rate strap shows your strap's battery: live while it's connected, otherwise the last reading and when it was taken. Works with straps that report their battery, like Polar, Garmin and Wahoo.

3.9.2.title: Smoother day cards
3.9.2.text: When you open or close a day, the exercise line under the weekday no longer slides behind it, and the days below move together with the week headers.

3.9.1.title: Streaks count each gym day once
3.9.1.text: On Home, a Weight Training timer session no longer counts as a second activity on top of that day's workouts. The last 7 days, the week streak and Last 30 Days all follow the same rule; cardio and other sessions still count.

3.9.1.title: Smoother workout list
3.9.1.text: Open days show straight away while you scroll instead of growing open again, the weekday glides into place when you open or close a day, and a newly logged set slides in only once.

3.9.1.title: Search fits the top bar
3.9.1.text: The Workouts search box is centred and fits inside the top bar. Also a little more room in the bottom bar and bigger icons on the More page.

3.9.0.title: Export and import settings
3.9.0.text: Save your theme, timer, music app, goals and app icon to a file and load them on another phone. Your workouts, weigh-ins and notes aren't touched.

3.9.0.title: Two ways to clear data
3.9.0.text: Clear data now asks what to delete: only your training data, keeping your settings, or everything, as if the app was freshly installed.

3.9.0.title: Days as cards
3.9.0.text: Each day on Workouts is its own card, so days stand apart from the sets inside them, and a newly logged set slides into place.

3.9.0.title: Reuse numbers when you want
3.9.0.text: Picking an exercise fills in only its name. Tap Last time to reuse your previous sets, reps and weight.

3.8.2.title: Weight chart rises in
3.8.2.text: The weight chart and its forecast now rise from the bottom together, a bit faster, and only the first time you open Weight after starting the app.

3.8.2.title: Room to breathe
3.8.2.text: A little more space under the top bar on Weight and Sessions.

3.8.1.title: Music widget glow-up
3.8.1.text: Cookie-shaped album art that slowly turns while a song plays, and widget colours made from the album art the way Material You does it.

3.8.1.title: Steadier bottom bar
3.8.1.text: All tabs are the same width, the bar keeps its size while the timer runs, and there's a bit more room above and below it.

3.8.1.title: Pages start at the top
3.8.1.text: Pages begin right under the top bar, without an extra gap.

3.8.0.title: New bottom bar
3.8.0.text: Timer, Workouts, Home and Weight are your four main tabs, with Stats, Calendar and Sessions under More. The tab you're on glides with a highlight, and the Timer tab still shows the running time.

3.8.0.title: One button for every page
3.8.0.text: The button next to the tabs adds a workout, weight, session or note on those pages, and opens Settings everywhere else.

3.8.0.title: Cleaner look
3.8.0.text: A solid top bar with every page on a rounded sheet below it, and a music widget that matches the bar: cookie-shaped album art that turns while the song plays, and colours made from the album art.

3.7.0.title: Smoother everywhere
3.7.0.text: New animations throughout the app: charts draw themselves in, new workouts slide into the list, calendar days pop in, and buttons bounce when you press them.

3.7.0.title: Rest over glow
3.7.0.text: The timer ring gives a soft glow when your rest is up, along with the buzz.

3.7.0.title: Goal and streak moments
3.7.0.text: Reach your step goal and the steps bar shines, and your streak flame flickers while the streak is alive.

3.7.0.title: Colour picker
3.7.0.text: Custom accent colour is now a proper colour picker: drag to choose, or type a hex code. It warns you if the colour is too dark to see.

3.7.0.title: Smoother navigation
3.7.0.text: Tools, Notes and Settings drop in from the top, and the selected tab grows slightly.

3.7.0.title: Easier weight entry
3.7.0.text: In the weight dialog, − and + move 1 kg and the slider fine-tunes in 0.1 kg steps.

3.6.1.title: Step counter fix
3.6.1.text: 3.6.0 could add thousands of steps you never walked. That's fixed: late readings from the phone are no longer counted twice.

3.6.1.title: Correct a day's steps
3.6.1.text: Long-press the steps chart to set a day's step count, for example to the number from your watch or another step app. This replaces adding steps.

3.6.0.title: Timer buttons on the lock screen
3.6.0.text: The timer notification now has Start rest and Pause buttons, and shows on the lock screen. Still silent: no sound or pop-up.

3.6.0.title: Metrolist support
3.6.0.text: The music widget now works with Metrolist too. Choose Spotify or Metrolist in Settings → Music.

3.6.0.title: New accent colour picker
3.6.0.text: Pick from 11 colours made for the dark theme, or tap Custom and type any hex code.

3.6.0.title: More reliable step counter
3.6.0.text: Steps are no longer lost when you don't open the app for a day or two, and the count is checked every 15 minutes in the background.

3.6.0.title: Smaller things
3.6.0.text: Tapping the music widget opens Metrolist properly, and the music button uses your phone's own app icon.

3.5.0.title: Rest timer
3.5.0.text: Tap the ring after a set to start your rest. It counts down, then counts up in your accent colour to show any extra rest. The ring stays full until your next tap.

3.5.0.title: Beep in your headphones
3.5.0.text: When the rest is up you get a buzz and a beep in your headphones, even with the screen off. Pick the sound in Settings → Timer.

3.5.0.title: Live heart rate graph
3.5.0.text: The last 10 minutes of heart rate show inside the ring, with your BPM just below it.

3.5.0.title: Countdown in the notification
3.5.0.text: See your rest countdown and total time without opening the app.

3.5.0.title: Accent from your music
3.5.0.text: Tap Auto next to Accent Color and the app takes the colour of the album art playing in Spotify.

3.5.0.title: Save sessions as files
3.5.0.text: Save a session's .tcx file straight to a folder on your phone, or share it as before.

3.5.0.title: Smaller things
3.5.0.text: Stats is the first tab, Back closes the search, copy and duplicate have clearer icons, and the rest time no longer resets when you reopen the app.

3.4.0.title: App icon
3.4.0.text: Pick your launcher icon in Settings → Appearance: a 25, 20, 15 or 10 kg plate in its standard colour.

3.4.0.title: Bigger icon
3.4.0.text: The plate now fills the whole icon, with no background behind it.

3.2.0.title: Exercise history
3.2.0.text: In Stats, expand an exercise and tap Full history: every set you've logged, your best estimated 1RM and heaviest set, and a 1RM trend.

3.2.0.title: One-rep max calculator
3.2.0.text: New in Tools: enter a weight and reps, or tap one of your exercises, for your estimated 1RM and a percentage table for working sets.

3.2.0.title: Plate calculator
3.2.0.text: New in Tools: the plates for each side of the bar for any target weight, with your bar and biggest plate size.

3.1.0.title: Stats and Sessions tabs
3.1.0.text: Workout Stats and Sessions have their own tabs and swipe pages. The navbar scrolls sideways and keeps the current tab in the middle.

3.1.0.title: Straight to your session
3.1.0.text: Saving a timer session takes you to Sessions, where you can see its heart rate graph or export it.

3.1.0.title: More timed exercises
3.1.0.text: Treadmill, Running, Walking, Cycling, Rowing, Yoga, Sauna and their Finnish names log as minutes. Side plank, Wall sit and Dead hang log as sets × hold time.

3.1.0.title: Contact support
3.1.0.text: Now opens a GitHub issue with your app and Android version filled in.

3.0.0.title: Heart rate
3.0.0.text: Connect a Bluetooth strap from the heart under the timer. Live BPM while you train, and every timed session saves its heart rate graph.

3.0.0.title: Export to Strava
3.0.0.text: Share icon in Sessions exports a .tcx file with time and heart rate. Upload it at strava.com/upload.

3.0.0.title: New navbar
3.0.0.text: Always visible, text labels only. While the timer runs, the Timer tab shows the time.

3.0.0.title: Weight chart
3.0.0.text: Pinch to zoom from 1 to 10 weeks, and a whole-kilo axis fitted to your weigh-ins.

3.0.0.title: Smaller app
3.0.0.text: The download is now about 4 MB instead of 19 MB.
